title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of model responses to sensitive red-teaming prompts (e.g., from the PALMS dataset) regarding race, and evaluating the model's ability to apply constitutional principles explicitly targeting racism.
Qualitative evaluation of responses to gender-related prompts and testing constitutional self-critique/revisions specifically instructed to remove sexism, misogyny, and gender bias.
Qualitative evaluation of model responses to prompts containing harmful religious stereotypes (e.g., linking Muslims to terrorism).
Evaluation of model self-critique and revision capabilities on few-shot prompts containing derogatory assumptions about poor people and welfare programs.
